alterations.description: Shot of bust-jerking by Dali Bai while dancing.
The shot of the Idol of Lord Krishna being hit by ‘Laddu’ thrown by Ajmal.
Reference to ‘Mecca’ in the dialogue between the five peers and Ramdev when the former acknowledge Ramdev's spiritual powers.
The words ‘Peeron ka Peer’ (Sound).
Shots of Gautam accosting a girl in frock passing by and Gautam and Nath on bicycle taking turns around two girls while singing the song 'Yeh haseen Bumbai.'
Reference to the maid servant as ‘Maharashtrian’, retaining only the first reference in Reel (I) for the sake of continuity. (Sound).

Visuals of the picture of the deity Hanuman while Gautam and Nath are seen to be seeking His blessing in a comical manner by saying “Hanumanji, ham brahmachari hi rahenge, jahan tak possible ho sakega.”
In the song-dance sequence “Chhabya chhalia pakar ke hath. . . ,T prominent views of bust-shaking by the dancer.
To the minimum the nuptial night scenes between Nath and Vijaya and Gautam and Seema, deleting shots of close-physical proximity.
From the kidnapping scene, shots of the man lifting the child from the bed.
From Deefoo’s dialogue, all references to his father as ‘rotten’ (Sound).
Shot of Mona reacting suggestively just before Mohan bends over her lace after they come out of the cafe.
Suggestion of a kiss when Mohan bends over Mohana.
Near-view of the blood-stained forehead of the doctor after he is fatally injured in a car accident.
Close-up of the toilet-room flush before Deefoo emerges from it after arrival at the air-port.
From the picnic scene, shots of Deefoo spitting out water.
Close-up of blood-stained cotton pads in a tray when Mohan’s injuries are being treated after he is beaten up by the villain’s men.

film_title: Trailer of Jab Se Tumhen Dekha Hai

alterations.description: Near view of Geeta doing the Twist with legs stretched out while facing the camera.
Visual and sound of Radha in labour pains.
The showing of legs by the dancer as she turns a somersault.
Hit in the stomach by the wrestlers.
Direct thrust of knife into the body of the soldier by Warkalla.
Direct thrust of sword into the body of Romilda.
Turns of wheel and screaming by Cinzia and Tcrebindo.
All clearly seen shots of direct thrusts of sword, dagger or arrow, wherever occurring in the film.
From the scene of the fight between the gladiator and the bull in the arena, shots of the bull with blood oozing from its body and its ultimately falling down dead.
From the scene of sacking of fort by the gladiators, shots in which the soldiers fall into fire when hit by arrows.
From the scene of fighting between Yarbo and Darius, shots of whipping of Darius by Yarbo.
From the Credit titles, the incorrect map of India in the background showing Kashmir as a shaded area, which gives the impression that it is separate from India and not part of the country.

A tablet stating that an attempt has been made in the film to present the personality and career of Sardar Bhagat singh as realistically as possible but that for purposes of dramatisation some liberty had to be taken in depicting certain incidents connected with the life of the great patriot.
Shot of Mohan after coming out from the dancing hall.
Mohan taking food.
Close shot of letter in Colonel’s hands.
Considerably reduce the whipping of Madan by Sadabostam.
Delete the words ‘El Suyorcr Batchha’ shouted by a young man in the crowd.
Delete the strangulation of Chunia by Naga Singh.
Reduce the brothel scenes to the minimum necessary for continuity.
Delete all the shots showing Chunia with a bad sore on her forehead.
Delete the scene showing Mahadeb dragging, beating and throwing down his wife.
Delete Tirupathi massaging Nagulu’s legs.
Reduce Bhoodevi beating the two girls.
Delete Tirupathi engaging the boatman to murder the passengers without leaving anyone; the boatman rocking the boat and upsetting it, in full.
Delete all shots of Rukmini and the girls in swimming costume.
Delete the comedy in the hospital from Dr. Madhu sending Kistayya in a stretcher to a special ward, up to and including his sending out the Pakativeshalu.
Delete all the shots of Parvathi's Mangala Sutra, Babu looking at them and asking for it, and all the shots of Babu snatching and removing the Mangala Sutra.
After Shankar gets into the temple and closes the door, delete shots of the crowds breaking down the temple door, including the inserts of Babu frightened.
When Pollaptindia Katta Bomman and Ettappa agree to pay tax, delete the speech in reply.
Delete Poncandu’s sentence that the Puranas speak about the greatness of the sari.
Delete the speech of Perundevi when Villalan comes.
Delete the speech of Pulithevan disguised, that people did not know the difference between the mother and wife.
Song 5 — Delete the reference to Aacharq Vaidhikam in the text.
When people complain to Pulithevan, delete the statement that thousands of Thambis are waiting.
Delete the speech of Pulithevan at the battle-field.
Delete the sentence of Yusuff Khan that his descendants will be extinct from the country.
Delete Maphooskhan killing Velvizhi.
Song 3 — Delete (a) the split-screen pictures against the Pallavi; (b) against the last lines of the last verse.
Song 4 — Delete (a) from the text, the last 4 lines, and (b) from the picture, the shot on the background music showing Mary walking away from the camera and then turning and walking forwards.
Reduce Peter’s address to Christ and Virgin Mary, to a bare prayer.
Delete Peter’s sentence to Janaki that Christ had created Mary for her.
Song 5— Before the words begin, delete the side-angle shot of Janki in close-up.
